unresolved.question: No vendor description of this report was found (only a glossary entry). What the Provider picker filters and what the single Report Date selects are unverified; the document reconstructs the report from comparable systems only.

What unlocks Show AR? It is greyed in our capture and in every vendor screenshot seen (Detail, Office, any transaction mix); the enabling rule is unknown. On the Executive Summary (Monthly Reports) the same option appends Total A/R; whether it does the same here is not stated.
What does Include Resp. Party Type add? "The responsible-party type on each line" is unverified.
Exact PATIENT TYPE rule: does General mean non-ortho patients only and Ortho ortho-flagged patients only? Unverified.

Transaction Date definition conflict inside the vendor texts: the editable ledger / posting date versus the date entered. Affects the date basis of Daily Journal, Deposit Slip and Special Transaction Report.

The criteria shown for PRODUCTION BY = Category and PRODUCTION BY = Carrier were not seen; category / carrier pickers are expected but unverified. The document says REPORT FORMAT Detail is selectable only for PRODUCTION BY = Provider, but that cannot be checked for Category and Carrier, whose states were not seen.

Is the SORT BY section (Transaction Date / Patient Lastname) tied to PRODUCTION BY = Provider or to REPORT FORMAT = Detail? The state was seen only with Detail selected. The default of SORT BY and of the PROVIDERS picker, and the state of Page Break and Fee Schedule To Compare under PRODUCTION BY = Provider, are not documented. An older (2016) sample of Production by Provider in the Summary format prints a compare-fee column, so the greying of Include UCR / Include Z-Codes may belong to REPORT FORMAT = Detail rather than to PRODUCTION BY = Provider.
With GROUP BY = Carrier: does the Page Break checkbox get a carrier label and does a carrier picker appear? Was Page Break by Provider ticked automatically or by the user in the sample?
Fee Schedule To Compare: the value list is not documented; the greyed default is presumably just the first fee schedule in the tenant list (unverified).

What enables Page Break (greyed while COLLECTION BY = None)? Do provider / carrier / code pickers appear for the other COLLECTION BY choices? The By Provider output echoes a Provider criterion in its footer, but the base screen has no provider picker.
REPORT FORMAT Summary is unverified, and whether COLLECTION BY Provider uses the transaction provider or the allocation provider is not stated.
What enables the GROUP BATCH CHECKS header checkbox (greyed in our capture with only Cash ticked)? Presumably the Check payment type - not stated. Its effect on the output is unverified.

Which dates does DATE RANGE select - appointment dates for scheduled production and posting dates for actual production? The document defines the three figures (scheduled, actual, estimated production) but not the date basis, and no vendor screenshot of this criteria screen or of the output is cited.

Scope question: the Routing Slip can also be printed from the Patient Overview (Print Reports > Routing Slip) and from the Scheduler (right-click Print > Routing Slip), the latter with its own options - Current appointment only / all appointments in the day for the current location / for all locations, an Appointment Date and Include Completed Procedures. They are not part of the Daily Reports criteria screen; decide whether the new module covers them.

Block appointments for events reportedly produce no slip - seen only as a search-result summary of a vendor article, not read in full. Does the appointment selection (DATE RANGE / Provider / Operatory) skip them?

SORT BY option spelling: our transcription could not tell whether the separator in the options Provider (Last Name) – Appointment Date and Operatory – Appointment Date is an en dash (as transcribed) or a plain hyphen; the document only repeats our transcription, so the exact legacy spelling stays open.

Does Missing unlock the Appointment Date basis and APPOINTMENTS TO INCLUDE (unverified - both are greyed under Detail)? What is their state under Unsigned? Does ALL list every appointment with its note status (unverified)? The document glosses the DOS Date / Created On Date basis as the note date of service / the note entry date, from our own transcription only - no vendor source is given.

Does ANALYSIS BY = Carrier enable the CARRIER picker and grey the CATEGORY picker? Only our default-state capture suggests it; there is no vendor source. Is the CATEGORY list the 14 categories of the SEARCH CODE dialog (unverified)?
Which provider does the Provider picker / column mean? The vendor article says the Preferred Provider and also defines it as the provider on the transaction date (conflict).
Page Break is greyed while GROUP BY = None and is ticked automatically for GROUP BY = Provider: can the user untick it then, or does it stay locked? Not stated.

Transaction in Ledger: one vendor text says a posted procedure counts only when its code is flagged Visit Code, another that the report shows transactions that are Ledger Codes - must a code carry both flags to count?

No vendor description of Claims Printed exists: the date basis of DATE RANGE (printed, created or sent date), whether e-claims are included, and what Detail / Summary and the Provider filter do are all inferred.
Amount dropdown: values other than All Amount are not documented, nor when the amount value box beside it unlocks.

EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE: the vendor article describes it as including only the selected patient types, which conflicts with the label - is it an include or an exclude filter? The criteria block printed at the top of the PDF output labels it Excluded Pat Types.

Do the Age Range From / To boxes unlock when Age Range is ticked (not stated)? The default of the hidden Sort By row is not documented. Is the Category list of CODE/CATEGORY the 14 SEARCH CODE categories (unverified)?
